title: Gemini 4 Carbon: Benchmarks, Pricing and Review (2026)
summary: Gemini 4 Carbon, released as Google's strongest model, affects AI automations. Understand what changed and how it impacts your automation tools.
body_markdown:
## What Activepieces has already shipped for Gemini 4 Carbon


There's **no shipped support to cite** , because we found no[Activepieces](https://www.activepieces.com/pieces/google-gemini) announcement naming Gemini 4 Carbon, and we haven't run the model ourselves. Anything below about Carbon in a flow's a method, not a result.


### The shipped support, with date and link


There's no date and no link, because we've found nothing that names the model. Activepieces lists a Google Gemini integration, but that says little about whether a specific model has a dedicated action with the right fields.


Until Activepieces or Google publishes one, assume Carbon has no built-in step. The Google Gemini integration lists 11 actions and 0 triggers, and none of that listing names Carbon, so it isn't proof that the model is covered.


### Trying Gemini 4 Carbon in a workflow


Test it as a plain API call you control, so a failure points at the model rather than at the connector.


Take the model identifier and request format from Google's own model page, not from a blog post or from us, because we can't confirm either.


To see the shape of the test, look at the builder. It has a Schedule trigger set to every hour, the integration selector open on spreadsheet actions such as Insert Row and Find Rows, and a successful sample-data run in the settings panel.


Before any model is involved, settle that the trigger fires and passes data on, which is what the sample-data run proves.


Once that run is clean, add an HTTP request step after the trigger that calls Google's endpoint with a fixed test prompt. Then add an Insert Row action that writes the raw response beside the prompt.


Map the response field explicitly instead of dumping the whole body, so a changed output shape breaks visibly. If the call is rejected, the identifier's the first thing to check.
